nodes.name: Patient-10
nodes.summary:
Patient-10, born on February 15, 1951, under case number URO-2026-0010, has advanced C61 Prostatakarzinom characterized by Gleason 4+5=9 (ISUP 5), cT4 cN1 cM1c staging, and a BRCA2-mutation, undergoing targeted therapy with a PARP-inhibitor and second-line Cabazitaxel 25 mg/m² q3w. Arzt-1.
